title: Reviewer Decisions and Effectuation in the Owning Plan — Appeals and Grievances
content:
**Appeals and Grievances: decisions and their effectuation**

The reviewer re-examines the determination under the tier's review basis. A medical necessity case is decided by a physician reviewer of the same or similar specialty who took no part in the denial where the tier requires both a physician reviewer and an independent reviewer. A case under review is decided upheld (the initial determination stands in full), overturned (reversed in full) or partially overturned (part reversed — some lines, some units or part of the amount).

An overturned decision is effectuated in the category that owns the subject within the tier's effectuation days under the tier's effectuation action: a claim line is reversed and adjudicated again, a denied authorization is issued, a nonpayment disenrollment or termination is reinstated. A partially overturned decision effectuates only the part reversed.

| Subject of the decided case | Owning plan or category | Effect of an overturned decision |
|---|---|---|
| a claim line under TRICARE Select | TRICARE Select | the line is reversed, the reversal reason being the appeal overturned, and adjudicated again |
| a claim line under TRICARE Prime | TRICARE Prime | the same |
| a claim line under a premium-based plan | TRICARE Premium-Based Plans | the same |
| a denied authorization | Referrals and Authorizations | the authorization is approved on appeal and issued |
| an enrollment ended for nonpayment | TRICARE Prime, TRICARE Select or TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, as the enrollment's plan | the enrollment is reinstated |

A partially overturned decision on a claim line or an authorization has the same effect limited to the part reversed: the line is adjudicated again at the decided amount, or the authorization is issued with the decided units.

**Further effects**

- Where the tier requires past-due payment first, a favorable decision on an enrollment is effectuated only after every past-due fee or premium is paid.
- The decision letter states the next-level rights and deadline where the tier's letter includes them.
- While the case is open, collection of the disputed beneficiary amount is suspended where the tier suspends collection during review.

**Basis Q&A**

*A medical necessity case is overturned in part: three of five requested days are granted on review. What is effectuated?* Only the part reversed — the authorization is issued with the decided units.
